note: 04A: a symbol with only a value (7) and an empty function cell is a call-position error: void-function v. Fe's one-namespace design resolves call position through the value cell, but its call-head error names the head symbol whatever the value is, so fe already emits the same 'void-function v' text -- for a structurally different reason, until Phase 4 makes the function cell the thing that is empty.
